text_block_list.text: —The first battle against the Queen. The preceding Japan Cup became a fierce contest.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Haaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Not this time! It's different from the summer! I won't let it be your one-woman show. Hyaaaaah!!

The Queen, Buena Vista, surges forward.
In pursuit comes Rulership's generation as well.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant* You've gotten stronger... haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
My gratitude—for your praise.
The Clan of the Rose will undoubtedly carry on your era.

The battle is carried over to the year-end Arima Kinen.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Now, it's my turn.
This'll be the prelude to the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's not a GⅠ, so there shouldn't be any problem
even if we don't stay overly on guard.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Huh, a different problem...?
The Arima Kinen is a race where fan voting determines eligibility, but...
choice_data_list: Our vote count's looking a little dicey...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat... Are you saying *I'm* unpopular?!
If my popularity is really slumping—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
To make a statement, I must win here,
no matter what it takes.
And at the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there he is.
It's Rulership!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
She is strong, no doubt... but
I can't shake the impression that she's inconsistent.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, the reason for the unpopularity is... the halo effect, perhaps?
If a poor first impression is dragging it down, then...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to completely change that perspective.
In this race, barring something extraordinary,
slipping up is...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh-What is that all about~?
Something huge must have happened! And to *two* of them!

Air Groove and Admire Groove.
Both of them were present at the venue.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, Trainer.
Thanks for always taking care of me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I was just... invited along, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I don't think one needs a reason
to come watch a race run by an Umamusume from their own academy.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking it's about time... to head to
the venue and see it for myself with my own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. Whether the running she envisions
is truly not just a pipe dream. And—”

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Can I hold my own at the top?
I'm going to find out.
...Air Groove might have her own thoughts on the matter.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: (What do I doooo... I can't make a careless move... If I mess up...)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Air Groove-san is gonna lecture me, and Alv will just scoff at me...
I wanna go home... but...)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Heh... Very well. Pressure of this degree is nothing. I am no longer the person I once was.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I will show you
how one truly wins a race—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: To small fries like you lot—!!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Hahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: I didn't hear a thing, all good!
